```artifact
Feature: System Access and Payment Processing
  As a chemist or patient
  As a user of the VIRTUA system
  When I log into the system
  Then I should access my prescriptions and invoices

Scenario: Chemists accessing the system
  Given chemists are using VIRTUA 3.3 with Django 2.0 and MySQL
  And the system is self-contained with no third-party data sharing
  When chemists log into the system
  Then I, as a chemist, should access my prescriptions and invoices

Scenario: Patients accessing the system
  Given chemists and patients are using VIRTUA 3.3 with Django 2.0 and MySQL
  And the system is self-contained with no third-party data sharing
  And patients have provided their email
  When patients log into the system
  Then I, as a patient, should receive an email with my full prescription and invoice

Scenario: Payment Gateway Integration
  Given chemists and patients are using VIRTUA 3.3 with Django 2.0 and MySQL
  And the system integrates with the standard payment gateway
  And the system supports Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and Safari
  When a payment is processed through the payment gateway
  Then the payment should be securely accepted via Debit/Credit Cards and Net banking

Scenario: Payment Processing Button
  Given chemists and patients are using VIRTUA 3.3 with Django 2.0 and MySQL
  And the system integrates with the standard payment gateway
  And the system supports Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and Safari
  When a chemist or patient initiates a payment
  And the payment method is either Debit/Credit Card or Net banking
  Then the payment should be processed securely

Scenario: Payment Processing Button with Edge Case
  Given chemists and patients are using VIRTUA 3.3 with Django 2.0 and MySQL
  And the system integrates with the standard payment gateway
  And the system supports Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and Safari
  When a chemist or patient initiates a payment
  And the payment method is not Debit/Credit Card or Net banking
  Then an appropriate error message should be displayed

Scenario: Browser Compatibility
  Given chemists and patients are using VIRTUA 3.3 with Django 2.0 and MySQL
  And the system integrates with the standard payment gateway
  And the system supports Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and Safari
  When a chemist or patient logs into the system from a supported browser
  Then the login should be successful

Scenario: Browser Compatibility with Edge Case
  Given chemists and patients are using VIRTUA 3.3 with Django 2.0 and MySQL
  And the system integrates with the standard payment gateway
  And the system supports Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and Safari
  When a chemist or patient logs into the system from an unsupported browser
  Then an appropriate error message should be displayed

Scenario: Unsupported Operating System
  Given chemists and patients are using VIRTUA 3.3 with Django 2.0 and MySQL
  And the system integrates with the standard payment gateway
  And the system supports Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and Safari
  When a chemist or patient logs into the system from an unsupported operating system
  Then an appropriate error message should be displayed
```
